title: ML prior-art extract queue
description: The ONE intermediate index, written once at merge and then FROZEN. It is the only record of what extraction was ASKED to produce, which is what makes it a different check from the records that exist. Its ORDER is part of the contract: rows are spawned in slices from a cursor, so a reordered queue re-spawns work already done under a key that no longer matches.

frozen_at.description: When the merge produced this queue. Written once.

queue.description: One admitted artifact per row, in spawn ORDER, carrying every param the extract spawn declares -- so a spawn never has to re-read a search output whose content can move after the freeze.

item_id.description: The canonical id. The record's filename DERIVES from it.

id_class.description: Which record kind this row will produce, and therefore which payload the child owes.

location.description: A resolvable URL. An artifact without one was never admissible.

found_by_angle.description: The angles that admitted this row, comma-joined. A SEQUENCE serialized to one line because every spawn param is a string; the sequence is the durable record and this is only its spawn projection.
